| Field | Value |
|-------|--------|
| **Description** | Open-source AI Agent + ADQA decision layer. Telegram, WhatsApp, X, Discord. BYOK. Hermes/OpenClaw compatible. |
| **Website** | https://narna.org |
| **Topics** | `ai-agent` `ai-agents` `agentic-ai` `telegram-bot` `whatsapp-bot` `mcp` `openclaw` `langgraph` `decision-intelligence` `ai-governance` `narna` `ugs` |
